Samira (security): Following up from today's all-hands sec Q&A: several customers asked how to validate exported audit bundles during an ISO/SOC review. TL;DR: we provide signed manifests + checksums and an optional HMAC verification file.

Ellen (prod): Can we get a short example of what auditors will see? A one-paragraph description would help sales.

Tara (compliance): Auditor-friendly phrasing: "Redwood provides daily signed audit bundles containing events (NDJSON), a manifest of files with SHA256 checksums, and a signature file to verify integrity. Customers may retain bundles in their own storage for arbitrary retention periods."

Diego (sre): Quick tech note: bundle layout example:
- exports/2026-07-05/<tenant>/audit-bundle-20260705.tar.gz
Inside: manifest.txt (file|sha256), events.ndjson.gz, signatures.asc, metadata.txt
manifest.txt sample line:  events.ndjson.gz|d2d2f8...
We also include a signed timestamp so auditors can confirm export time.

Lucas (sales): Perfect. Also customers asked whether BYOQ attestation proves key origin vs BYOK. Short answer?

Samira (security): BYOK = customer keys managed in a cloud KMS we integrate with; we never see plaintext. BYOQ = customer supplies key material stored in their HSM; we record an HSM attestation blob (certificate from the HSM vendor) and include that blob in the audit bundle. Attestation proves the key was generated/contained in an approved HSM but does not share key material.

Tara (compliance): Addendum: auditors often ask for rotation evidence. We can include a rotation log (timestamp + key-id + operator) in the bundle when requested.

Diego (sre): Side note on Private/VPC: control-plane request logs are emitted from the edge before proxying; records include vpc-id and source ip. Data-plane inference logs are not stored unless customer enables full-log export. Enabling full logs increases bundle size; we surface estimated size in console.

Export Bot: Reminder: "Audit exports walkthrough" office hours scheduled at 1980081600. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.company/officehours-security

Ellen (prod): Action items: Samira/Tara to draft the one-paragraph auditor description + rotation evidence note; Diego to add bundle layout to docs; Lucas will add the one-liner to sales enablement. We'll close by EOD Friday.

Samira (security): Ack. I'll draft the bundle verification steps (sha256 verify + gpg --verify) and post them here.

Lucas (sales): Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
